title: Design System: Unslog — The Frosted Pane

display.purpose: Headlines, nav links, buttons, body prose — one type voice; hierarchy by weight and size, never uppercase tracking.

mono.purpose: Fit scores, dates, salaries, counts — every number a user scans to compare.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent), 0 8px 24px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 10%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Frosted panels/cards/stats float over the ambient glow.

shadows.name: button-bevel
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, white 25%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Glass buttons' top highlight, matching the sign-in screen's glass-button material.

motion.name: score-fill
motion.purpose: The score dial's indigo fill rises on load/update; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: interactive-state
motion.purpose: Nav links, tags, and buttons transition state changes; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ambient-glow
motion.purpose: The slow-drifting two-colour radial glow behind the sidebar and the whole app; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: page-entrance
motion.purpose: Every page's content fades and un-blurs in on navigation, centralized in Layout.tsx.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid action-indigo filled button, e.g. Save, Apply, Mark as applied.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #5b4fe8; background: #5b4fe8; color: #fcfcfc; font-family: 'Geist Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(91,79,232,0.45); }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Translucent, backdrop-blurred secondary button over the ambient glow — the sign-in screen's glass-button material, adapted to a 44px rectangle for dense dashboard use.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #b8bac0; background: linear-gradient(-75deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.4), rgba(255,255,255,0.75), rgba(255,255,255,0.4)); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #171717; font-family: 'Geist Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }

components.name: Fit Score
components.description: Frosted circular fit score (0-100); an indigo fill rises from the bottom in proportion to the score. No rotation (the old system's ink-stamp rotation is retired with it).
components.html: 86
components.css: .ds-score { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #171717; border: 1.5px solid #b8bac0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; } .ds-score-fill { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(0deg, #5b4fe8, transparent); opacity: 0.22; transform-origin: bottom; transition: transform 400ms ease-out; } .ds-score-num { position: relative; }

components.name: Tag — Good (pill)
components.description: Pill-shaped good/confirmed tag (e.g. visa clear), indigo-soft fill. Replaces the old navy ink-stamp square tag.
components.css: .ds-tag-good { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Geist Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(91,79,232,0.4); border-radius: 999px; background: #ecebfc; color: #5b4fe8; }

components.name: Closed Card Badge
components.description: Closed/rejected pipeline card: the application stays fully visible at 68% opacity under a small 'Closed' pill badge in the corner. Replaces the old diagonal hand-stamped VOID mark (SVG feTurbulence distressed edge) — that stamped-ink texture was specific to the retired paper-ticket world.
components.css: .ds-card-void { position: relative; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); border: 1px solid #e4e5e8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; opacity: 0.68; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: #171717; } .ds-closed-badge { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #e24b36; border: 1px solid rgba(226,75,54,0.45); background: rgba(226,75,54,0.1); border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; }

components.name: Ambient Glow
components.description: The slow-drifting two-colour radial glow behind the whole app (faint) and behind the sidebar (stronger), the material every backdrop-blurred panel genuinely blurs. Direct continuation of the sign-in screen's GradientBackground component, re-expressed in pure CSS so every page can share it without extra DOM.
components.css: .ds-glow { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 12% 18%, rgba(91,79,232,0.2) 0%, transparent 42%), radial-gradient(circle at 88% 82%, rgba(194,61,149,0.16) 0%, transparent 45%); filter: blur(60px); animation: glow-float-a 26s ease-in-out infinite; }

narrative.overview:
The sign-in screen introduced a specific material: neutral glass chrome — buttons, inputs, and panels in translucent, blurred ink/paper — floating over a slow-drifting two-colour radial glow. This system carries that same pane of glass into every page of the dashboard, not just the login screen, so the whole app reads as one continuous material rather than a styled lobby in front of a differently-styled building.

This replaces the prior "Ticket Wallet" system (flat ink-bordered ticket stock, condensed-caps display type, a hand-stamped VOID mark, dashed tear perforations) wholesale, per explicit user request to reuse the new sign-in page's theme everywhere while keeping every page's functionality identical. Product truth, every page's structure, every data flow, and every interaction are unchanged — this is a full re-skin, not a rebuild. The product's one load-bearing constraint carries over in translation: fit scores and visa/residency flags stay instantly scannable, now via a frosted score dial and pill tags rather than an ink stamp and square ticket tags.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral ink/paper chrome everywhere — buttons, borders, and body text carry no hue of their own. Colour is reserved for what must stay scannable or for the ambient glow, never for decoration.
A faint, slowly-drifting two-colour radial glow (indigo + magenta) sits behind the whole app and a stronger version behind the sidebar. Every backdrop-filter: blur() panel genuinely blurs this glow.
Geist (variable) for all display and body type; IBM Plex Mono kept, narrowly, for genuinely tabular figures.
Rounded throughout on the shadcn --radius scale (6/8/10px, pill for tags and small controls).
Soft elevation: translucent panels carry a blurred shadow instead of the old system's flat, shadow-free ink borders.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule, translated
rules.body: Action-indigo is the only colour allowed to signal "act on this" or "this is live" in UI chrome — carried over unchanged from the old system, with the hue swapped from jet red to indigo so it can double as a glow stop colour.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-an-Effect Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur() only appears on a surface that sits over the ambient glow. Glass is never applied where there is nothing behind it to blur.

rules.name: The One Type Voice Rule
rules.body: Geist carries both display and body type; hierarchy comes from weight and size, never from uppercase tracking or a second display face. Mono is reserved for genuinely tabular figures.

dos: Do keep IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals for every score, date, salary, and count.
Do reserve backdrop-filter: blur() for surfaces that sit over the ambient glow; never add it decoratively.
Do keep action-indigo reserved for primary actions and the one "live/actionable" signal per view.
Do keep attention-magenta scoped to duplicate-sighting / follow-up-due signals only.
donts: Don't reintroduce uppercase condensed display type for body prose.
Don't add glass/blur to a panel with no ambient glow behind it.
Don't mix attention-magenta and action-indigo as competing accents on the same element.
